name: asplit
title: Split an array along a margin

origin.description: MARGIN is 1-based. The array is stored column-major.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An Array with a positive dimension.

origin.details: A character margin is matched against the names of the dimnames. The check splits a 2 by 3 matrix along rows.
origin.example:
bp_asplit <- getFromNamespace("asplit", "backports")
x <- matrix(1:6, 2, 3)
sp <- bp_asplit(x, 1)
print(sp[[1]])
print(sp[[2]])
